components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Compact high-emphasis action with a quiet pressed response.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.625rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius, 0.625rem); background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font: 500 0.875rem/1.25 var(--font-sans, sans-serif); white-space: nowrap; transition: all 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.8; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Neutral secondary action that gains a muted surface on interaction.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.625rem; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius, 0.625rem); background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); font: 500 0.875rem/1.25 var(--font-sans, sans-serif); transition: all 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--muted); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Low-emphasis toolbar or navigation action, transparent until needed.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.625rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius, 0.625rem); background: transparent; color: var(--foreground); font: 500 0.875rem/1.25 var(--font-sans, sans-serif); transition: all 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--muted); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Compact transparent field with a strong accessible focus boundary.
components.css: .ds-input { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; height: 2rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.625rem; border: 1px solid var(--input); border-radius: var(--radius, 0.625rem); background: transparent; color: var(--foreground); font: 400 0.875rem/1.429 var(--font-sans, sans-serif); transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--ring); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Default Badge
components.description: Small pill for status or compact emphasis.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: fit-content; height: 1.25rem; padding: 0.125rem 0.5rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font: 500 0.75rem/1.333 var(--font-sans, sans-serif); white-space: nowrap; transition: opacity 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-badge:hover { opacity: 0.8; } .ds-badge:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Paper surface separated primarily by a hairline ring.
components.html:
Workspace notes

Last edited a few minutes ago
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.25rem; padding: 1rem; border-radius: calc(var(--radius, 0.625rem) + 0.25rem); background: var(--card); color: var(--card-foreground); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 10%, transparent); font-family: var(--font-sans, sans-serif); } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.375; font-weight: 500; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted-foreground); font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.429; } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent), 0 1px 3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); } .ds-card:focus-within { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Tab Group
components.description: Muted compact rail with a lightly raised active tab.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 2rem; padding: 3px; border-radius: var(--radius, 0.625rem); background: var(--muted); } .ds-tab { height: calc(100% - 1px); padding: 0.125rem 0.375rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: calc(var(--radius, 0.625rem) - 0.125rem); background: transparent; color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 60%, transparent); font: 500 0.875rem/1.25 var(--font-sans, sans-serif); transition: all 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--foreground); } .ds-tab[aria-selected="true"] { background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 1px 2px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Sidebar Navigation Item
components.description: Compact navigation row with muted active and hover surfaces.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; width: 16rem; flex-direction: column; gap: 0; padding: 0.5rem; background: var(--sidebar); color: var(--sidebar-foreground); } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; width: 100%; height: 2rem; padding: 0.5rem; border: 0; border-radius: calc(var(--radius, 0.625rem) - 0.125rem); background: transparent; color: inherit; font: 400 0.875rem/1.429 var(--font-sans, sans-serif); text-align: left; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-nav-item:hover, .ds-nav-item[aria-current="page"] { background: var(--sidebar-accent); color: var(--sidebar-accent-foreground); } .ds-nav-item[aria-current="page"] { font-weight: 500; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--sidebar-ring); }

components.name: Dialog
components.description: Compact paper overlay with restrained blur, ring, and fast motion.
components.html:
Rename workspace

Choose a clear name for this organization.
components.css: .ds-dialog-stage { display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 2rem; background: rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); backdrop-filter: blur(4px); } .ds-dialog { box-sizing: border-box; width: min(24rem, calc(100% - 2rem)); padding: 1rem; border-radius: calc(var(--radius, 0.625rem) + 0.25rem); background: var(--popover); color: var(--popover-foreground); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 10%, transparent), 0 10px 15px -3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); font-family: var(--font-sans, sans-serif); } .ds-dialog h2 { margin: 0 0 0.5rem; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1; font-weight: 500; } .ds-dialog p { margin: 0 0 1rem; color: var(--muted-foreground); font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.429; } .ds-dialog-input { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; height: 2rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.625rem; border: 1px solid var(--input); border-radius: var(--radius, 0.625rem); background: transparent; color: var(--foreground); } .ds-dialog-input:hover { border-color: var(--ring); } .ds-dialog-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

narrative.overview:
Lunaris treats the interface as a dependable work surface: calm enough for long writing sessions, compact enough for complex workspaces, and precise enough for team workflows. Warm paper-and-ink neutrals keep attention on documents and tools. Hierarchy comes from spacing, weight, and tonal contrast before scale or decoration.

Color and imagery enter as bounded portals rather than ambient chrome. Auth, onboarding, announcements, and other meaningful moments may use colorful or stylized imagery, while the operational organization stays neutral and focused. The result should feel minimal without becoming sterile, and approachable without becoming soft or toy-like.
keyCharacteristics: Warm monochrome foundations in both light and dark themes.
Compact controls with clear state changes and generous focus visibility.
Rounded, bordered surfaces with restrained elevation.
Dense desktop organizations that simplify into direct mobile hierarchies.
Colorful imagery contained within deliberate, clipped portal regions.

rules.name: Paper Before Pigment
rules.body: Routine application chrome stays in Paper & Ink neutrals. Saturated color belongs to status, data, or a bounded image portal with a clear purpose.

rules.name: Quiet Hierarchy
rules.body: Inside the application, increase weight and spacing before increasing type size. Operational page titles stop at the established headline role; marketing-scale display type does not enter the organization.

rules.name: Workbench Density
rules.body: Keep controls compact and local to their task, then create calm through grouped whitespace around sections rather than inflating every control.

rules.name: Layer Only When Needed
rules.body: A surface earns shadow by moving, floating, or responding. Static hierarchy uses borders and tone.

rules.name: Radius Ladder
rules.body: Match radius to scale and role: tighter for dense navigation, standard for controls, broader for containers, full only for inherently pill-shaped or circular elements.

rules.name: Compact Control
rules.body: Default controls occupy the established compact height. Increase size only when touch context, content, or task importance requires it.

dos: Do use semantic theme variables so every component remains coherent in light and dark modes.
Do build hierarchy with grouping, weight, and tonal contrast before adding size or shadow.
Do preserve clear keyboard focus, reduced-motion behavior, and the accessible reading-font option.
Do keep colorful imagery inside intentional portals with strong clipping and neutral surroundings.
Do simplify panel structures into direct hierarchy and sheet patterns on mobile.
donts: Don't add saturated accent colors to routine organization chrome.
Don't turn every section into a floating card or stack multiple shadow levels without interaction meaning.
Don't use marketing-scale type inside editor, workspace, or settings workflows.
Don't mix arbitrary corner radii; follow the radius ladder and component role.
Don't spread decorative imagery behind dense controls or document content.
